title: Targeting MYCN Degradation by HLB-0532259 Induces Senescence in Retinoblastoma.
snippet: Amplification of MYCN is a primary driver of aggressive retinoblastoma (RB), yet it remains a challenging therapeutic target. This study aimed to evaluate the therapeutic potential of the PROTAC molecule HLB-0532259 in degrading MYCN and suppressing RB growth.
